rationale.consistency: Mirrors v6 client shape (NewClient, authCtx, checkResponse, closeResponse/drainAndClose, httperr sentinels); CheckResponse signature differs from v6's (r) vs (r, err) and test pkg named provtest under dir test/.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409 find-by-name, nil/empty upload URL, int32 overflow, ctx cancel during retry wait, aborted/completed while polling; but unexpected statuses (e.g. running) poll forever and unknown abort reasons send code 0 rather than null.
rationale.scope: Stays on local-execution path; v1 run --out cloud untouched. Adds a clientcfg package and refactors createCloudTest into prepareCloudTest, both justified; Client keeps unused version/stackID fields.
rationale.readability: Clear layering (api/client/errors/http_client/notify/provision) and good names; comments are thorough though occasionally chatty.
rationale.robustness: Retries with rewindable bodies, drained/closed responses, bounded notify timeout, per-attempt readers for upload, scoped token never hits env; nil cloudClient would panic in newMetricsClient only if metricsURL unset (not reachable today).
rationale.maintainability: Output switches on a single provisioningMode flag with injectable pusher/notifier; expv2 accepts URL/client overrides without breaking exported API; runtime-config mapping isolated in one helper.
